question: Analyze the soccer match dataset to determine the champion team for each season across all countries and leagues, awarding 3 points for every win, 1 point for every tie, and 0 points for every loss. For each season, return the champion’s team name, the league, the country, and the total points accumulated.
sql:
WITH match_points AS (
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal > m.away_team_goal THEN 3
             WHEN m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END AS points
    FROM Match m
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.season,
        m.league_id,
        m.country_id,
        m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        CASE WHEN m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal THEN 3
             WHEN m.away_team_goal = m.home_team_goal THEN 1
             ELSE 0 END AS points
    FROM Match m
),
team_points AS (
    SELECT 
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM match_points
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        tp.season,
        tp.league_id,
        tp.country_id,
        t.team_long_name AS team_name,
        l.name AS league_name,
        c.name AS country_name,
        CAST(tp.total_points AS INTEGER) AS total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.season, tp.league_id ORDER BY tp.total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM team_points tp
    JOIN Team t ON tp.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
    JOIN League l ON tp.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON tp.country_id = c.id
)
SELECT 
    season,
    team_name,
    league_name,
    country_name,
    total_points
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY season, country_name, league_name
